modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: April 12 is observed as Commemoration of first human in space by Yuri Gagarin: International Day of Human Space Flight.
On April 12, 1983: Harold Washington was elected as the first African-American mayor of Chicago.
On April 12, 1981: The first launch of a Space Shuttle (Columbia) takes place: The STS-1 mission.
On April 12, 1961: Space Race: The Soviet cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin becomes the first human to travel into outer space and perform the first crewed orbital flight, Vostok 1.
On April 12, 1937: Sir Frank Whittle ground-tests the first jet engine designed to power an aircraft, at Rugby, England.
